title: AccumulationStatusView
description: Source of truth: derived projection of FeedbackSignal × Manifest(kind: standing-policy) (Operational, Category C). Computed by elohim-storage on Signal::FeedbackSignalCreated and Signal::ManifestUpdated{kind: standing-policy} events. Not persisted as DHT; reconstructable from the underlying FeedbackSignal entries and standing-policy Manifest payload.

entityType.description: The type of entity this accumulation status applies to (e.g. 'content', 'path')

entityId.description: The identifier of the entity this accumulation status applies to

totalSignals.description: Total count of FeedbackSignal entries for this (entityType, entityId)

uniqueParticipants.description: Count of distinct signer pubkeys across FeedbackSignal entries for this entity

consensusStrength.description: Normalized consensus strength in [0, 1]. 1.0 = full consensus; 0.0 = maximum diversity. Derived from normalized Shannon entropy of signal_kind distribution.

status.description: Computed accumulation status: 'pending' means insufficient signals; other values derive from standing-policy Manifest threshold comparison.

settled.description: True when totalSignals >= threshold.settled.minTotalSignals AND consensusStrength >= threshold.settled.maxConsensusStrength (read as minConsensusStrength for 'settled')

policyManifestCid.description: CID of the standing-policy Manifest whose thresholds were applied. Null when protocol defaults were used.

computedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this projection was last computed
